actions.quantity: the entire exact unreserved source stack
actions.metadata: exact normalized item identity plus equal cost, description, modifier, slot, and structured variant

actions.quantity: one bounded positive unreserved quantity; serialized or equipment-section rows move only as one whole item
actions.sourceIdentity: retained for partial discard and removed for whole discard
actions.metadata: strict private before evidence retained in the operation journal

projection.trainerAuthority: authenticated GM or player controlling the exact Trainer
projection.groupAuthority: authenticated GM only for split, merge, and discard
safeFields: opaque offer, source, destination, confirmation, and revision requirement IDs
container, section, presentation-row, and item labels

commitAuthority.declaration: strict schema-v1 action, source, quantity, destination, confirmation, and revision matching against a freshly recomputed offer
commitAuthority.privateCommand: strict source and destination before rows, stable IDs, exact section and container, expected revision, quantity, and deterministic split ID
commitAuthority.staleEvidence: any source, destination, metadata, row identity, quantity, reservation, revision, or exploration-lock drift fails before mutation
commitAuthority.safeInteger: all quantities, sums, revisions, and row bounds fail closed outside supported safe-integer limits
commitAuthority.atomicity: inventory mutation, accepted adapter receipt, authoritative document revision, and persisted realtime events commit in one transaction or roll back
commitAuthority.responses: accepted authoritative sheets or group inventories replace local state; the browser never patches quantities optimistically

interaction.composition: 60/40 inventory and inline decision workspace, collapsing to one column
interaction.rowControls: ordinary actions and quieter stack management use two compact wrapping groups
interaction.uncertainBoundary: exact retry remains the only mutation path; refresh, cancellation, source switching, and competing inventory changes stay blocked
